description: Cruise ships with their line, class, year, tonnage, capacity, rating, status, and page link. Narrow by line, by a region they sail (e.g. "Mediterranean"), by a name search, by minimum overall rating, or by status (in service, upcoming, retired); sort by name, size, newest, or rating.

in_service.description: true keeps only ships sailing now (same as status in-service)

line.description: A cruise line's slug or UUID

min_rating.description: Only ships rated at least this overall

query.description: Case-insensitive match against the ship's name or class

region.description: Case-insensitive match against the regions a ship sails

sort.description: space = most gross tons per guest (least crowded); renovated = most recent refit first

status.description: upcoming = announced, not yet sailed; retired = left the fleet

name: list_cruise_ships
title: Find cruise ships
